newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts MCI EPS view.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon cuts MCI EPS view.

text.p: Salomon Brothers analyst Jack Grubman slashed his earnings estimates on MCI Communications Corp for 1997 and 1998 but kept his buy rating on the stock.

The analyst said he cut his 1997 earnings estimate to $1.15 from $1.60 per share and his 1998 estimate to $1.30 from $2.15 per share after the company said late Thursday that heavy investments in local service would depress earnings.

Grubman said he would have dropped his buy rating on MCI stock if it was a standalone company but that he was preserving it because MCI trades as a function of British Telecommunications Plc's share price.
Grubman dismissed the prospect that the BT-MCI merger was at risk of not being completed.
"We can 100 percent state that the BT Board of Directors knew about MCI's plans and more importantly were 100 percent behind MCI's efforts," the analyst said in a research note.
"One could argue the industrial logic behind the BT-MCI merger was to allow MCI to do what they are doing, namely more aggressively attack Bell local markets."
"There is no deal risk whatsoever," he said.
He argued that the MCI earnings announcement was motivated in part by a desire to put pressure on U.S. regulators to open local markets to more competition.
